note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and name their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole run at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, in a single playthrough with no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so the work is the grind, not the skill.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end. It is a story trophy, so it pops when the mission wraps, and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Keep playing the story until Chapter 1 closes. Before it ends, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, because the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when Chapter 2 ends. After the mission Coffee Break in this chapter you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which opens most of the free-roam list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops at the end of Chapter 3. Yago's timed street race appears in this chapter, so save first and race as soon as it shows up, since its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when Chapter 4 ends. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of this chapter, opens bank vault robberies, so take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the final mission is done. Keep a manual save from just before it, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is your only way back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the mission Breakfast Run is complete. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the mission Child's Play ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the mission Headliners ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the mission VCIA Takedown ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when the mission Operation Savage Glory ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The long one. After the story, the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It needs 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges, 100 WAiNK spots, 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of the 255 animals studied, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 15 of the 18 meditation spots and Bret's hunting quest. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy and the reason the platinum takes about 200 hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the 250. Keep going to 300, since 100% completion needs that many.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity the game offers: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, bowling, drone races and the rest. One try of each type is enough, so work through the list early and tick types off as you meet them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two shooting ranges hold 42 gold medals between them. Work through every challenge at both ranges and take gold in each one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations. Win at least one race at each of them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 races that are all different events. Street races, drone races and the rest all count, but winning the same race twice only counts once.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Landing fish also feeds your Combat Focus meter, about 10% a fish, so the time is not wasted.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Any of the four in-game arcade games counts. Pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand of side missions, ending with his final mission. Side strands stay open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand of side missions, ending with his final mission. Side strands stay open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand of side missions, ending with his final mission. Side strands stay open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count, because they have their own trophies, so pick other quest givers. Yago's timed race in Chapter 3 counts, so save before it and race as soon as it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand of side missions, ending with his final mission. Side strands stay open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand of side missions, ending with his final mission. Side strands stay open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy that may be missable, so handle it from Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. Do the first one in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony of Jason's house and accept. It disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed yet whether it is required, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last spots need both characters playable, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Note that the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is a separate count.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. It is part of the 100% checklist, so finish the whole questline rather than stopping at one animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Find and complete 3 full sets of collectible cards scattered across Leonida. Cards are a slow hunt, so pick them up whenever you pass one instead of leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app. Any mix of the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags works, and there are more than 100 spots in the world, so you can skip the awkward ones.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges listed under Progress, Challenges. Most fill in on their own while you play, and 100% completion needs 70, so keep pushing past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and leave the red heat zone. It only pops once you are clear of the heat, not when you merely leave the flashing search area. A bank vault escape with your partner earns this at the same time.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app. You do not need to drive them, so scan traffic as you drive past. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 and R3 while aiming. Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, and adrenaline stretches it out. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and drop five of them with an assault rifle before the meter runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work, and planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed, so fly about 1 km away from the airport before expecting it. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Chapter 3 job, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use it on a store's locked back door. Kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If anyone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Each vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level right away, and the 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get clear of the heat. Like the other robbery trophies, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not when you merely slip out of sight.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the corners, including the Keys and the farmland, so fly a grid over the state once you can.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this one pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known, so the description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars and keep playing. It may pop while you play normally.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known, so the description is the only hint: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Try driving a car through a showroom window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game. The description's follow-through is the hint, and the exact trigger is still being pinned down at launch, so play it through and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Both Jason and Lucia need to reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind as you play through the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known. The description hints that the second try is the one that works, so if something fails once, try it again.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known. Two leads are going around and neither is confirmed: a stairwell room in Crosstown, across from the Pawn & Gun, that can fill with glowing graffiti hiding a six-digit code for the safe on the ground floor; and a UFO abduction side story Lucia can find in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known. The description is the hint: knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs. Sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: The $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it fills in as you buy clothes, food, weapons and the rest. It should pop on its own before the end of a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
